title: Ownership cleanup
contract: Release each acquired resource exactly once, including failure paths.
scope: 0..3 resources with unique IDs; optional failure after acquisition; abstract cleanup trace.
assumptions: Exactly the abstract finite model and input domain described in scope; no claim about LLMLang implementation or unbounded executions.

obligations.claim: Release multiset equals acquire multiset, no duplicate release, and release occurs after acquisition.

variants.description: Skip the final release on failure.
